fact: The Minister of Digital Transformation, with the Minister of Public Service, supervised the launch of a twelve-week cybersecurity and artificial-intelligence training programme for 300 civil servants from various government sectors, run by the Centre de Formation et d'Echange a Distance with the German cooperation office (AMI).
system: Programme de formation en cybersecurite et intelligence artificielle (qualification du fonctionnaire)

fact: The Ministry of Digital Transformation announced the launch of the Temekoun national platform to give public service staff basic digital skills throughout their careers, with GIZ support and certification.

GIZ Mauritanie says the DIGITAL-Y project (BMZ-funded, GIZ-implemented) completed cybersecurity and artificial-intelligence courses at the CFED, under the ministry MTNMA, aimed at training 150 participants in each from the Mauritanian public sector.

The Minister of Digital Transformation and Modernisation of the Administration launched a 12-week cybersecurity and AI training programme at the Centre de Formation et d'Echange a Distance for 300 civil servants from government sectors, with German cooperation.

The Minister of Digital Transformation opened a workshop on 7 June 2024 presenting the national Tamakkun platform, built with German cooperation (GIZ), to train public servants in basic digital skills.
The Ministry of Digital Transformation said an upcoming awareness campaign will give particular attention to training civil servants and state agents in digital good practice and cybersecurity.
